import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
def bfs(i, m):
    H,W=i.shape; D=np.full((H,W),np.inf); q=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if i[r,c]==m]
    for r,c in q: D[r,c]=0
    while q:
        r,c=q.pop()
        for dr in (-1,0,1):
            for dc in (-1,0,1):
                nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and D[nr,nc]>D[r,c]+1:
                    D[nr,nc]=D[r,c]+1; q.append((nr,nc))
    return D
def analyze(p):
    i=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} input']); o=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} output'])
    vals,_=np.unique(i,return_counts=True)
    bg,oth=vals[np.argmax(vals[0],axis=0)],vals[vals==vals.count()]
    vals,count_=np.unique(i,return_counts=True)
    bg=vals[count_.argmax()]; m=vals[count_.argmin()]
    D=bfs(i,m)
    kept=(i==bg)&(o==bg); newbg=(i==bg)&(o!=bg)
    print(f'--- demo{p}: bg={bg}, marker={m}')
    print('nkept',int(kept.sum()),'of which dist<2:',int((kept&(D<2)).sum()),'<3:',int((kept&(D<3)).sum()))
    print('newbg n=',int(newbg.sum()),'dist hist:')
    for d in sorted(set(D[newbg])):
        n=int((D==d&newbg).sum())
        if n: print('  ',d,n)
analyze(1); analyze(2); analyze(3)

import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def bfs(i,m):
    H,W=i.shape; D=np.full((H,W),np.inf); q=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if i[r,c]==m]
    for r,c in q: D[r,c]=0
    while q:
        r,c=q.pop(); v=D[r,c]+1
        for dr in(-1,0,1):
            for dc in(-1,0,1):
                nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and D[nr,nc]>v: D[nr,nc]=v; q.append((nr,nc))
    return D
for p in [1,2,3,4,5]:
    i=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} input']); o=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} output'])
    vals,_=np.unique(i,return_counts=True)
    bg=vals[np.argmax(vals)]
    recbg=(i==bg)&(o!=bg); kept=(i==bg)&(o==bg)
